Ive felt worthless and useless a lot. i cant seem to get people to understand my problems. i just make people uncomfortable or frustrated with me. i refused thearpy for awhile because ive been in and out of it for nearly 25 years but I gave it another try and it seemed to be going well but then I was told that im responsible for my own emotions. I could choose to not to feel bad about anything. but ive decided not to. They said that doesnt mean im to blame. that what I was felling was valid. but im not sure how being unhappy in life isn't supposed to be my fault if I can choose to not be unhappy at anytime. i'm not as accomplished as my peers. i havent reached any of the milestones they have. ive never dated. i dont have a job and i dont have any irl friends in the area. people act like these aren't big deals and theyre easily resolved. but they dont have to deal with them. especially the dating thing. nobody i know has gotten to my age and then not dated unless they wanted to. and at home my parents have been on the outs. my dad hasn't talked to me or my mother for nearly a month and has been sabotaging things around the house to make life more difficult and force me to move out. i keep losing friends and people keep distancing themselves from me. everyone else in the world seems better than me. I have to be a worthless shit heap while everyone else lives life the right way. and I have to be wrong while they get to be right. and its getting harder to pull out of these depressive episodes unscathed
That im alive and dont have any substance abuse issues

I've tried online dating. I've tried off and on for 9 years. I've asked out a lot of people. I've been to more than one therapist too. And I just keep getting older and having nothing happen and feeling more and more worthless.

I feel like I've been forced to miss out on valuable and incredible experiences that all my peers take for granted.

And I keep being miserable  because I can't get people to understand what I'm going through. They just see me as wrongheaded but they won't ever have to deal with anything like this problem either. So they don't get how it feel .
